title.en: Pull-ups, pull-downs, and a button that bounces
title.zh-CN: 上拉、下拉，以及会抖动的按钮

summary.en: An open input is not a voltage. The pulls in the SoC give it one. Debounce is software on top of that, not a second electrical fact.
summary.zh-CN: 悬空的输入不是一个电压。SoC 里的上下拉给它一个。去抖是加在这上面的软件，不是另一条电气事实。

text.en:
A GPIO input reads high when the pin is at 3.3 V and low when it is at 0 V. Leave the pin floating and the reading is not a decision. The pad has an internal pull-up and an internal pull-down. On the BCM2835-family table each is between 50 kΩ and 65 kΩ.

GP2 and GP3 are the exception. They have fixed 1.8 kΩ resistors up to 3.3 V, because they are the I2C pins. You do not turn those off in software. Every other GPIO pull is under software control. After reset the pins come up as inputs, and the default pull for each one is in the BCM2835 peripherals datasheet, which this lesson does not transcribe.

Wire a button between a GPIO and ground, and enable the pull-up. Released, the pull holds the pin high. Pressed, the pin is shorted to 0 V and reads low. That is the wiring gpiozero's Button uses when pull_up is true. The other legal wiring is a button to the 3.3 V pin with the pull-down enabled: pressed reads high. A button to the 5 V pin is the damage case from the previous lesson.

Contacts bounce. For a few milliseconds the metal chatters and the pin rings between high and low. The SoC does not publish a debounce setting for that. gpiozero's Button takes bounce_time in seconds and ignores edges inside that window. That is a software filter. The trace below is a model of the same idea: raw chatter, then a reading that waits until the line has been stable.
text.zh-CN:
GPIO 输入在脚为 3.3 V 时读高，在 0 V 时读低。脚悬空时，读数做不了决定。焊盘有内部上拉和内部下拉。BCM2835 系列表里，每一个都在 50 kΩ 到 65 kΩ 之间。

GP2 和 GP3 是例外。它们有固定的 1.8 kΩ 电阻拉到 3.3 V，因为它们是 I2C 脚。软件关不掉这两只。其余 GPIO 的上下拉由软件控制。复位之后这些脚作为输入起来，每一只的默认上下拉写在 BCM2835 外设手册里，本课不抄那张表。

按钮接在 GPIO 和地之间，并打开上拉。松开时上拉把脚保持为高。按下时脚被短到 0 V，读为低。这就是 gpiozero 的 Button 在 pull_up 为 true 时用的接法。另一种合法接法是按钮接到 3.3 V 脚并打开下拉：按下读高。按钮接到 5 V 脚，就是上一课里的损坏情形。

触点会抖动。几毫秒里金属弹跳，脚在高低之间来回。SoC 没有公布一个去抖设置。gpiozero 的 Button 用秒做单位接收 bounce_time，并忽略这段时间里的边沿。那是软件滤波。下面的轨迹是同一个想法的模型：先是原始抖动，然后是等到线路稳定才给出的读数。

prompt.en: A button sits between a GPIO and ground, and the pull-up is on. What does the pin read when the button is released?
prompt.zh-CN: 按钮接在 GPIO 和地之间，上拉开着。松开按钮时这只脚读到什么？

choices.en: Low, because the pull-up drains the pin
choices.zh-CN: 低，因为上拉把脚放空了

choices.en: High, because the pull-up holds it at 3.3 V
choices.zh-CN: 高，因为上拉把它保持在 3.3 V

choices.en: 5 V, from the neighbouring power pin

explain.en: With the switch open, the pull-up is the only thing connected. It holds the input at 3.3 V, which reads as high. Pressing the button ties the pin to ground.
explain.zh-CN: 开关断开时，只连着上拉。它把输入保持在 3.3 V，读为高。按下按钮把脚接到地。

prompt.en: Which pins have a fixed 1.8 kΩ pull-up that software does not remove?
prompt.zh-CN: 哪些脚有软件去不掉的固定 1.8 kΩ 上拉？

explain.en: The GPIO page says GP2 (SDA) and GP3 (SCL) have fixed 1.8 kΩ resistors. Other pins can have their pulls changed in software. The on-chip pull itself, when enabled, is in the 50 kΩ to 65 kΩ range.
explain.zh-CN: GPIO 页面写明 GP2（SDA）和 GP3（SCL）有固定的 1.8 kΩ 电阻。其他脚的上下拉可以在软件里改。片内上拉或下拉打开时，阻值在 50 kΩ 到 65 kΩ。

choices.en: It is a hardware register in the BCM2835, documented on the GPIO page
choices.zh-CN: 它是 BCM2835 里的硬件寄存器，GPIO 页面有记载

choices.en: It is a software argument on gpiozero's Button
choices.zh-CN: 它是 gpiozero 的 Button 上的软件参数

choices.en: It is the 1.8 kΩ resistor on GP2
choices.zh-CN: 它是 GP2 上的 1.8 kΩ 电阻

explain.en: gpiozero documents bounce_time on Button, in seconds. The GPIO page documents pulls and thresholds. It does not document a debounce register.
explain.zh-CN: gpiozero 把 Button 的 bounce_time 记为秒。GPIO 页面记载上下拉和阈值。它没有记载去抖寄存器。
